More at {{l|en|rural}}. {{doublet|en|Raum}}, a surname from German. {{col-bottom}} The word superficially appears to be an exception to the {{w|Great Vowel Shift}}, which might have produced the pronunciation {{IPAchar|/ɹaʊm/}}, but the retention of Middle English {{IPAchar|/uː/}} before {{IPAchar|/m/}} is regular. In fact, {{IPAchar|/aʊ/}} does not occur before non-[[coronal]] consonants in Standard Modern English native vocabulary.
